rcp-obstruccion.title: CPR and Airway Obstruction
rcp-obstruccion.summary: Training in CPR, AED use, and choking management in adults and children.
topics: Chest compressions in adults and children
Choking management in adults and children

pab.title: Basic First Aid, CPR & AED
pab.summary: Initial emergency response with hands-only CPR, AED use, and bleeding control.
topics: Initial steps and activating the emergency system
Hands-only CPR in adults and children
Recognizing medical emergencies (heart attack, stroke, seizures, asthma, hypoglycemia)
Safe patient handoff to emergency responders

pae.title: Standard First Aid, CPR & AED
pae.summary: Full first-aid coverage including CPR, AED, trauma, medical, and environmental emergencies.
topics: CPR with compressions and ventilations in adults and children
Bleeding control, bandaging, and chest/abdomen injuries
Spinal motion restriction and vital signs
Medical emergencies (stroke, heart attack, seizures, asthma, hypoglycemia)

sangrados.title: Bleeding Control, CPR & AED
sangrados.summary: Brief training in hands-only CPR, AED use, and control of critical bleeding.

recert.title: First Aid, CPR & AED Recertification
recert.summary: Simulations and hands-on stations for brigades that need recertification.
topics: Drill and evaluation of brigade personnel
Bandaging for chest and abdomen trauma

extintores.title: Basic Fire Extinguisher Use
extintores.summary: Safe use of fire extinguishers, fuel types, and extinguishing methods.
topics: Assessment of the company's existing equipment

mangueras.title: Fire Hose Operation
mangueras.summary: Guided practice on deploying, connecting, and advancing fire hoses.

brigadas.title: Emergency Brigade Training
brigadas.summary: Comprehensive brigade training: extinguishers, hoses, fixed systems, and scene handoff.
topics: Guidelines for scene handoff to emergency responders

evaluativo.title: Brigade Evaluation Program
evaluativo.summary: Drill with performance evaluation and feedback based on findings.

hazmat.title: Initial Hazardous Materials (HAZMAT) Incident Response
hazmat.summary: Initial response to hazardous-materials incidents for corporate brigades.
topics: Introduction and classification of hazardous materials (GHS and UN)
Identifying chemical, physical, and biological hazards
Proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
The brigade's role within the response plan
Theoretical-operational simulations and decision-making under pressure
Coordination with internal and external protocols

laboratorio-fuego-espumas.title: Fire & Foam Lab
laboratorio-fuego-espumas.summary: Practical, controlled training to recognize fire behavior by fuel type and master the correct use of foam agents for extinguishing.

primeros-auxilios-psicologicos.title: Psychological First Aid
primeros-auxilios-psicologicos.summary: Emergency response isn't only physical: this program prepares the brigade to provide immediate emotional support to victims and coworkers during and after a critical incident.
